season.evidence: Stored Jun-Sep. Ascent histogram May 8, Jun 16, Jul 20, Aug 36, Sep 13, Oct 6. Web search (SummitPost, Mountaineers, Cascade Climbers): Needle Pass is steep snow/ice late May to July, moat or loose dirt late season; Aug is the busiest month. Jun-Sep holds.

notes: Every report on the peak describes the South Corner route (cannon hole, rappels). None names a northwest face or corner climb, so the NW Face/Corner row has no positive evidence. Recent reports (2026) approach via the unofficial Mildred Lakes route with heavy bushwhack because Needle Pass is closed by the Bear Gulch fire; the stored South Corner approach may want a Mildred Lakes alternative. South Corner already holds a track.
